question_text: A uniform rope of mass M and length L lies on a smooth horizontal surface and is pulled at one end by a force F. The tension at the midpoint of the rope is:

question_text: Which of the following statements about friction are correct?

options.A: Friction always acts opposite to the direction of motion of the body
options.B: Static friction can take any value from zero up to its limiting value
options.C: The limiting static friction is proportional to the normal reaction
options.D: Kinetic friction is generally less than the limiting static friction

explanation: Friction on a walking person acts forward, so the claim that friction always opposes the body's motion is false. The other three are standard properties of friction.
subject: Physics

question_text: A body of mass m is in a lift that accelerates upward with acceleration a. Which statements are correct?

options.A: The true weight of the body changes
options.B: The apparent weight is m(g + a)
options.C: The apparent weight is m(g − a)
options.D: The normal reaction on the body exceeds mg

explanation: N − mg = ma gives N = m(g + a), which is greater than mg. The true weight mg does not change.
subject: Physics
